requirement.description: Layout objects incorrectly implement __int__ method which raises TypeError, but some code paths expect them to be convertible to integers.
requirement.contract: Layout.__int__ should either properly implement integer conversion or be removed if not intended for integer conversion. The method should not raise TypeError in contexts where integer conversion is expected.

requirement.description: Missing 'metadata' attribute on Cat objects prevents proper AST processing.
requirement.contract: Cat objects should have a metadata attribute to support AST traversal and simulation-time formatting.

requirement.description: List objects being called as functions causes TypeError when they shouldn't be callable.
requirement.contract: List objects should not be treated as callable functions, and proper error checking should prevent this misuse.

requirement.description: Fragment objects are incorrectly indexed with Fragment objects causing TypeError.
requirement.contract: Fragment indexing logic should properly validate indices and handle Fragment objects correctly.

requirement.description: Incorrect validation prevents valid constant values from being added as ports.
requirement.contract: Port validation should accept valid constant values as ports when appropriate, not reject them with TypeError.
